title: BADA BEAT
oneLiner: Tap out the BADA rhythm, grab the glowing beats, and dodge the offbeat blobs!
mechanics: The bright BADA mascot auto-runs across a one-screen music lane while left/right shifts between three lanes.
Press A on the beat to pulse and collect nearby glowing beat notes; correctly timed pulses chain the combo up to x8.
Blue notes score 100 and refill the pulse meter; offbeat red blobs hurt, while a missed note simply passes.
Every 12 seconds, a short recovery phrase is followed by a denser phrase, capped at three hazards at once.

controls.a: Pulse on the beat to collect notes and destroy small offbeat blobs
controls.b: Hold briefly to show the next beat lane

lose: The player loses all three hearts after colliding with three red blobs or missing three pulse beats in one phrase.
scoring: Collect blue beats for 100 points; consecutive correctly timed pulses raise the visible combo to x8, then reset it after a miss.
